title: feat(sdk): send speech inputs and add audioTransform
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Split out of #14472 (website v2 Play), which needs these methods.

- Fix: `audioSpeech` now sends `duration` and `seed`. Before, it dropped both even though its options type accepted them.
- Adds `referenceAudio` on a new `AudioSpeechOptions` type (sent as `reference_audio`). It is not on the shared `AudioGenerateOptions`, because GET `/audio/{text}` and `generateAudio` don't accept it.
- Adds `audioTransform(file, { operation, model?, voice? })`, which posts multipart `audio` to `/v1/audio/voice-changer` or `/v1/audio/voice-isolator`. `voice` is sent only to the voice changer.
- No version bump. The website uses the SDK through `file:`, and npm releases get bumped separately.

Change from Elliot's branch: it sent `reference_audio` on the GET route, where gen's query schema silently strips it.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The hive gets a soundboard
gist.blurb: The SDK can now send a reference clip for speech and turn uploaded audio into a different voice or an isolated one. It also remembers the duration and seed you asked for.
gist.summary: The SDK now sends duration, seed, and reference_audio in audioSpeech requests and adds audioTransform(file, { operation, model?, voice? }) for multipart voice-changer and voice-isolator requests.
gist.impact: Developers can control speech generation as intended and upload audio to /v1/audio/voice-changer or /v1/audio/voice-isolator, with voice applied only to voice-changing requests.

A CRT monitor robot listens nearby, with code-plants growing around the equipment.
